title: The Echo of the Deep Anew
author: Edmund Thornbury
blurb: Odile Yarrow, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
